genres.short_definition: Two people move toward intimacy; ends in earned HEA or HFN.
genres.sibling_notes: Not tragedy-by-default. Passion-crime may involve lovers but centers irreversible harm + aftermath, not romance contract.
genres.ending_contract: HEA or HFN required; fade/ambiguous commitment fails

genres.short_definition: A death (or imminent murder) structured as fair-play puzzle and/or suspense; reveal recontextualizes planted clues.
genres.sibling_notes: Differs from crime-of-passion: engine is concealment + clue craft, not emotional eruption. Passion motive OK if fair clues drive the ending.
genres.ending_contract: Fair reveal + consequence; unsolved shrug fails

genres.short_definition: Emotion-driven irreversible act rooted in intimacy/jealousy/betrayal, plus moral and emotional aftermath.
genres.sibling_notes: Not a whodunit lane. Heat and cost matter more than clue parade. May overlap murder factually but craft focus is passion → rupture → consequence.
genres.ending_contract: On-page irreversible act + aftermath cost; fade-before-choice fails
